technical-summary: Added immutable provider-neutral session-surface capability value types as the AS29 foundation contract, with import-neutrality and scalar-only tests.
user-summary-candidate: Added the shared session-surface capability contract needed for provider-managed agent sessions.

technical-summary: Registered and validated the safe session-open child identity event projection fields introduced by AS17.
user-summary-candidate: Improved session-open event conformance while keeping process identity details safely bounded.

technical-summary: Fixed a chain of real bugs surfaced while independently verifying SH13/SH15/SH18 gateway worker output (worker self-reports had falsely claimed green/complete in several cases): (1) close_llm_session leaked provider-session-ref, now redacted via a shared _public_session_projection helper; (2) agents_gateway_api.submit_llm_request/run_llm_request rejected the _dispatch_service_root kwarg the HTTP service layer already sent, breaking every real service-path submission; (3) InMemoryGatewayRegistry.register() derived profile generation from a per-instance counter that reset on every registry rebuild, so reload never actually changed generation and silently defeated CON-AGW-101 stale-snapshot rejection — now a content digest; (4) submit_llm_request never resolved a snapshot from the live gateway-owned registry at all, so shared-mode admission was effectively unimplemented despite the validation machinery existing — now resolves and persists the full snapshot identity when a registry is installed; (5) deleted agents_gateway_api.reconcile_gateway_state, a dead second recovery authority with zero callers that violated the single-recovery-authority boundary; (6) wired SH15's progress-summary helper into request_runtime_status/wait_llm_request (result['progress']) and added gateway_overview's runtime-fingerprint; (7) fixed a regression where AS33's capability-snapshot projection had been silently dropped from request_runtime_status, restored via a new schema-tolerant raw session read; (8) added live session-handle latest-turn-event tracking. Also fixed several test-authoring bugs (fabricated client API calls, wrong event-handler arity, fake application double used where the real one was needed, a structurally-impossible test ordering) blocking SH13's integration suite. Entire tests/unit/agents/ + tests/integration/agents/ suite (267+ tests) is fully green.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed several real bugs in the shared gateway that were silently breaking profile-reload rejection, session-close redaction, session capability diagnostics, and service-path request submission — found by independently re-verifying worker-reported completions rather than trusting their self-reports.

technical-summary: Corrected the AS29 session-surface descriptor YAML key to session_surfaces and replaced the broad tuple[Any, ...] annotation with a forward-referenced SessionSurfaceDeclaration tuple, preserving import layering.
user-summary-candidate: Session-surface provider descriptors now use the documented field name and carry an accurate typed declaration contract.

technical-summary: Restored stale-non-live runtime projection for persisted active or closing sessions without a live runtime, and made session listing observational by using the runtime peek path. Added coverage for stale closing and non-live runtime cases.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway session listing now correctly identifies stale persisted sessions without starting a runtime.

technical-summary: Added provider-neutral session-surface resolution with explicit project-root/provider inputs, installed-version and exact normalized platform selection, selected-evidence validation ceilings, neutral unsupported identities, adapter-ref containment, registered descriptor validation errors, and conservative OpenCode ACP/CLI declarations with platform-specific evidence.
user-summary-candidate: Provider session surfaces now resolve through a safe, platform-specific capability snapshot without overstating unverified OpenCode support.

technical-summary: AS29 slice 5a: Added resolve_session_surface() and prepare_provider_session_transport() to the public providers API boundary. PreparedSessionTransport carries transport, resolved surface snapshot, and effective provider ref without exposing descriptor/adapter/protocol/native values. Unsupported surfaces produce no live transport (transport=None). Existing prepare_provider_acp_launch contract preserved for backward compatibility.
user-summary-candidate: Resolved session-surface snapshots now available through the public providers API; prepare_provider_session_transport returns typed result with surface snapshot and transport.

technical-summary: AS29 slice 5a: Added resolve_session_surface() and prepare_provider_session_transport() to the public providers API boundary. PreparedSessionTransport carries transport, resolved surface snapshot, and effective provider ref without exposing descriptor/adapter/protocol/native values. Unsupported surfaces produce no live transport (transport=None). Existing prepare_provider_acp_launch contract preserved for backward compatibility.
user-summary-candidate: Resolved session-surface snapshots now available through the public providers API; prepare_provider_session_transport returns typed result with surface snapshot and transport.

technical-summary: Fixed submit_llm_request never passing service_root into store.admit_record, silently skipping the admission-phase work-index entry (phase='admitted') that SH07 recovery relies on to discover admitted-but-unclaimed requests after a crash — found while building real Docker concurrency tests, since it made the crash-matrix suite's admitted-but-unclaimed scenario untestable. Also added a --gateway-profiles-config CLI flag to agents_gateway_service_process.py so the real subprocess entry point can run in shared/gateway-owned-registry mode (previously only the in-process GatewayServiceHost.create() supported it, meaning no real-subprocess test could ever exercise SH13's shared-registry guarantees).
user-summary-candidate: Fixed a gap where the gateway's crash-recovery evidence for admitted-but-unclaimed requests was never actually written in production, and enabled the real gateway subprocess to run in shared multi-project mode for testing.

technical-summary: Added AS28 characterization tests for current ACP session behavior and a bounded migration-debt inventory that will tighten to a zero-ACP agent boundary after neutral transport migration. Corrected a malformed comment that prevented module parsing.
user-summary-candidate: Session transport migration now has behavior-preservation tests and an explicit inventory of ACP dependencies to remove.

technical-summary: Added the foundation-neutral agent session transport contract, bounded observations, canonical control request/result semantics, protocol conformance tests, and registered validation errors. SessionControlAction now has one canonical foundation home with compatibility re-export for session-surface consumers.
user-summary-candidate: Agent sessions now have a provider-neutral transport and control contract ready for the ACP adapter migration.

technical-summary: Added the private ACP-to-neutral AgentSessionTransport wrapper, bounded raw-event mapping, canonical control semantics, and direct-module export boundary tests. Removed the ACP wrapper from general transport exports so agents cannot import it through the public foundation package.
user-summary-candidate: ACP sessions can now be adapted through the neutral transport contract without exposing ACP internals to gateway code.

technical-summary: Added the provider-side AS28 transport factory bridge. It resolves the AS29 session surface once, returns the same frozen snapshot in PreparedSessionTransport, wraps supported OpenCode ACP launches privately, and returns no transport for unsupported routes without process launch or fallback.
user-summary-candidate: Provider session transport preparation now respects exact capability snapshots and safely declines unsupported routes.

technical-summary: Reclassified local-openai's execution_isolation_tier from no-isolation to full-isolation. The gateway's disposable-worker dispatch path (agents_gateway_worker_host.py) hard-rejects any non-full-isolation provider with UNS-AGW-076, which meant local-openai (a pure REST client with zero local config/CLI surface to isolate) could never successfully complete a real gateway dispatch. This was masked until test_gateway_concurrency.py needed a real successful completion rather than a mid-flight crash.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed the shared agent gateway rejecting every real request to the local OpenAI-compatible provider; concurrent gateway load against it now works end-to-end.

technical-summary: Added AS37 with a capability-gated layered status projection design, linked it to AS21, and filled execution/standards detail in dependent AS plans. The design separates lifecycle from terminal outcome and defers unsupported activity/progress fields.
user-summary-candidate: Agent status planning now distinguishes trustworthy evidence-backed state from future diagnostic detail.

technical-summary: Migrated the SessionRuntime open path to prepare and store a neutral PreparedSessionTransport through providers_api. Unsupported surfaces now fail before launch; legacy ACP prompt/cancel/close paths remain for later AS28 slices.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway session opening now uses the provider-neutral transport bridge and safely rejects unsupported surfaces before launch.

technical-summary: Corrected the session-surface enum parser's set-like input annotation so declared mutable and immutable value sets match the type contract without changing parser behavior.
user-summary-candidate: Session-surface descriptor validation now has an accurate set-like type contract.

technical-summary: SH08 Slice A rewrite: resource_key_for now resolves from provider isolation tier instead of profile params, distinct_projects is genuinely computed from project keys instead of hardcoded to 0, per_resource buckets keyed by resolved resource key instead of literal profile_id, ContentionSample schema matches RV732 immutable-snapshot spec with wait percentiles and config generation tracking. All R1-R6 fixes applied and validated (61 tests passing).
user-summary-candidate: Implemented immutable contention snapshots with resolved resource keys and genuine project-count tracking for gateway capacity planning.

technical-summary: Completed SH07 closure validation: focused gateway durability tests cover profile lanes, replay-required recovery, transactional work-index handling, interrupted lifecycle mapping, and six Docker subprocess/SIGKILL crash scenarios including claimed-before-running and terminal-before-cleanup windows.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway durability and recovery behavior is now validated through focused tests and real Docker crash scenarios.

technical-summary: AS28 slice 4b-A foundation: SessionTurnResult now includes bounded final_summary field populated by AcpAgentSessionTransport.prompt() from assistant-message fragments. Dispatch reads final_summary instead of reconstructing output from AcpResult.events. Uses SessionTurnResult.observations_delivered + dropped_observations for total-events. Atomic migration of agents_gateway_sessions.py (group B) deferred to gateway agent work.
user-summary-candidate: Session transport now carries bounded assistant output through final_summary field instead of raw event reconstruction. ACP adapter collects text fragments safely.

technical-summary: Added bounded traceback diagnostic capture to stderr on unexpected worker exceptions. The worker host now writes exception class/message and bounded traceback to operator-only stderr (never crosses the protocol pipe). The supervisor captures this stderr as a bounded redacted diagnostic in error details for INT-AGW-076. Protocol stdout remains clean with only the redacted error envelope.
title: SH21: multiline prompt transport and safe worker diagnostics
user-summary-candidate: Worker diagnostics: unexpected exceptions now produce bounded tracebacks in operator stderr without contaminating the protocol pipe or public response.

technical-summary: SH10 Slice A: Added CLI wiring for gateway lifecycle operations. New commands: gateway status, drain, resume, stop [--force], recover [--confirm] [--reason]. Status/drain/resume/stop delegate exactly once through StandaloneGatewayClient (HTTP) and print redacted JSON. Recover invokes recover_unprovable_owner directly (never HTTP, because the service may be dead). CLI handlers contain no lifecycle/store/signal logic. Added 17 focused unit tests covering all commands, force flag forwarding, recover bypassing HTTP, busy graceful stop error surfacing, and architecture boundary enforcement.
user-summary-candidate: Added CLI lifecycle commands for the gateway service: status, drain, resume, stop (with optional --force), and recover (record-only dead-owner recovery with --confirm guard).

technical-summary: SH10 Slice A: CLI wiring for gateway lifecycle operations. Added 5 operator sub-commands (status, drain, resume, stop [--force], recover [--confirm] [--reason]) to audiagentic gateway CLI, dispatching through StandaloneGatewayClient HTTP interface or direct record-only recovery module. 17 new unit tests verify dispatch-only semantics with no lifecycle-logic leakage into CLI handlers.
user-summary-candidate: Added CLI commands for gateway operator lifecycle control (drain, resume, stop, recover)

technical-summary: AS28 slice 4b-A: removed AcpResult/AcpEvent reconstruction from the agents layer. agents_gateway_sessions.py now returns the neutral SessionTurnResult directly from AgentSessionTransport.prompt() instead of rebuilding a legacy AcpResult from collected AcpEvents. agents_gateway_turn_events.py's projector, timeline recorder, and on_event callback now consume TransportObservation/TransportObservationKind natively instead of AcpEvent. agents_gateway_session_dispatch.py already read SessionTurnResult.final_summary. Deleted the now-unused _transport_kind_to_acp_kind mapping table.
user-summary-candidate: Simplified the agent session pipeline to use the provider-neutral transport contract end-to-end, removing a legacy ACP-specific reconstruction step.

technical-summary: Pass service_root=project_root in cmd_gateway_recover so gateway recover --project PATH operates on the resolved project root instead of CWD.
user-summary-candidate: Fix gateway recover to honor --project path argument

technical-summary: SH21 partial: worker_host.py's except-Exception handler now writes a bounded, redacted traceback to operator-only stderr (never the protocol pipe stdout) before emitting the INT-AGW-076 error envelope. worker.py's supervisor now captures the child's stderr via spawn_supervised(stderr=subprocess.PIPE) and attaches a bounded diagnostic to the raised AudiaGenticError.details. Does not fix the underlying newline-truncation root cause documented in SH21 notes, which is reserved for concurrent Codex work.
user-summary-candidate: Unexpected gateway worker failures now carry a bounded diagnostic traceback for operators instead of a fully opaque error.
